mainEntity.name: How long does a trip and fall case take to resolve?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a trip and fall case varies significantly based on several factors, including the complexity of the accident, the severity of your injuries, the responsiveness of the insurance companies, and whether a lawsuit needs to be filed. Simple cases might settle in a few months, while more complex ones involving extensive negotiations, multiple parties, or litigation can take a year or more. Your attorney can provide a more specific estimate once they have reviewed the details of your situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Case resolution time varies greatly, from a few months for simple cases to over a year for complex ones, depending on factors like injury severity and litigation.
